in_sanskrit.name: भीमसेन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भीम (bhīm) - strong, powerful, fearless, Bhīma being a revered name in Hindu mythology for the second of the Pandava brothers, and सेन (sēna) - army, strength, protection.

in_hindi.name: भीमसेन
in_hindi.long_meaning: भीम (bhīm) - बढ़ावा (bhaṛāvā) - strong, powerful, Bhīm being a revered name in Hindu mythology for the second of the Pandava brothers, and सेन (sēna) - शक्तिशाली (śaktiśālī) - strength, protection.

in_tamil.name: பிம்சன
in_tamil.long_meaning: பிம் (pim) - போர் (pōr) - strong, powerful, Bhīm being a revered name in Hindu mythology for the second of the Pandava brothers, and சன (caṉ) - கட்டல்வது (kaṭṭalvadu) - strength, protection.

in_telugu.name: భీమదేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: భీమ (bhīm) - బృహత్ (bhrīhatu) - strong, powerful, Bhīm being a revered name in Hindu mythology for the second of the Pandava brothers, and దీప్య (dīpya) - శక్తిశాలి (śaktiśāli) - strength, protection.

in_marathi.name: Bhimsen
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhimsen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhimsen is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'powerful' or 'strong'. In Hindu mythology, Bhimsen is an avatar of Lord Vishnu, known for his immense strength and courage.
